title: Clopen coproduct partition data for fppf sheaves
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], use its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site] and the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $I$ be a small set in this convention. Let $(G_i)_{i\in I}$ be sheaves of sets on this site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $T\to S$ be a site object. For an open subset $U\subseteq T$, write $T_U\to S$ for its open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] with its induced map to $S$, and $\iota_U:T_U\to T$ for the inclusion. A coproduct partition datum for $(G_i)$ on $T$ consists of open subsets $U_i\subseteq T$ that are closed, pairwise disjoint and cover $T$, together with sections $s_i\in G_i(T_{U_i})$. Empty pieces and an empty index set are allowed. For a sheaf of sets $C$, maps $c_i:G_i\to C$, and $a\in C(T)$, define the predicate that this datum maps to $a$ to mean $c_i(s_i)=\iota_{U_i}^*a$ for every $i$. This is only the data and the component-image predicate: it asserts neither existence nor uniqueness of a partition for a given section.
